_comment: Flutter Panel egg. Import via Admin → Nests → Import egg.
name: Rust (Carbon)
author: flutter.software
description: Rust dedicated server with the Carbon modding framework. Runtime and installer are both Debian 12 (bookworm, glibc 2.36). Carbon updates on every start. Primary allocation is the game port (UDP 28015); add the query port (27017) as an extra allocation so the server shows in the browser. Give it 10-16 GB RAM.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Installs Rust (app 258550) with SteamCMD. Carbon itself is downloaded by the
# runtime image's entrypoint on every start when FRAMEWORK=carbon.
SRCDS_APPID=258550

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz

export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

BETA_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ]]; then
  BETA_ARGS+=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
fi

set +u
./steamcmd.sh +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 \
  +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
  +login anonymous \
  +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${BETA_ARGS[@]}" validate +quit
set -u

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
[[ -f linux32/steamclient.so ]] && cp -f linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
[[ -f linux64/steamclient.so ]] && cp -f linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

chmod +x /mnt/server/RustDedicated 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[flutter] Rust install finished. Carbon will be fetched on first start."

variables.name: Modding Framework
variables.description: carbon, oxide, or vanilla. Carbon and Oxide are re-downloaded on every start.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Server browser description. Use \n for new lines.

variables.name: Level
variables.description: Procedural Map, Barren, HapisIsland, SavasIsland, CraggyIsland

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: Procedural map size (1000-6000). Ignored when Custom Map URL is set.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: Procedural map seed. Blank = random. Ignored when Custom Map URL is set.

variables.name: Custom Map URL
variables.description: Direct download URL to a .map file. Leave blank for procedural.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Server browser query port. Add it as an extra allocation.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: WebRCON port. The panel console talks to it inside the container; only allocate it if you use an external RCON tool.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: WebRCON password. Change this. The panel console needs it.

variables.name: Rust+ App Port
variables.description: Rust+ companion app port. -1 disables it.

variables.name: Server URL
variables.description: Website shown in the server browser

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = update Rust with SteamCMD on every start, 0 = skip

variables.name: Steam Beta Branch
variables.description: Steam beta branch (blank = public). Reinstall after changing.
